status: RECOMMENDATION ONLY — NOT EXECUTED, NOT PREREGISTERED, NOT AUTHORIZED
requires: a new product-owner authorization permitting provider spend. §178 made zero provider calls and this file changes that in no way.

whyAReplicateDesignIsNowMandatory.problem: §175 attempt 2 and §177 phase B each executed ONE stochastic sample per row over ten rows. Nine rows behaved identically and one changed. That design cannot attribute a one-row difference to a prompt edit, which is why PRECISION_IMPROVEMENT_CAUSALLY_ESTABLISHED = FALSE stands against an otherwise attractive 5/5.
whyAReplicateDesignIsNowMandatory.consequence: a third single-execution run under v15 would produce another number nobody may interpret. The instrument is not exhausted, but the one-shot design is.
whyAReplicateDesignIsNowMandatory.precedent: the programme already owns the pattern — the §152–§154 hardened baseline/replicate2/replicate3 triplet at one fixed identity.

1_promptIdentity.wireSchemaSha256: recompute at preregistration from the representative schema built from the same input shape, exactly as the §177 preregistration did
1_promptIdentity.rule: bind the hash, not only the label — §138 established that the version string does not uniquely identify behaviour, and §177 is the case where the label moved while the bytes did not

2_providerAndModel.model: the exact model identity, pinned and asserted against the returned model on every row
2_providerAndModel.rule: an execution budget and model identity that are unresolved at freeze time make the object unfreezable

3_rowsAndTruth.instrument: the frozen ten-row balanced instrument, unchanged
3_rowsAndTruth.rowTextHashes: the §174 frozen hashes, re-verified from the actual bytes at preflight
3_rowsAndTruth.truth: the §174 HUMAN_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED verdicts, unchanged and not re-authored
3_rowsAndTruth.rule: ROW_TEXT_MUTATION_ALLOWED = FALSE still holds; if a row text moves, its verdict is void

4_replicateCount.requirement: fixed BEFORE any output is seen, and never chosen or extended after looking at results
4_replicateCount.guidance: the design must be able to separate a per-row rate from a single draw. Three replicates per row is the programme's own precedent (§152–§154); more is better and costs linearly. State the number, the total call count and the resulting cost in the preregistration.
4_replicateCount.forbidden: selecting, extending or truncating the replicate count after seeing any output

parametersToPreregisterBEFOREAnySpend.5_executionOrder: state the row order and the replicate interleaving explicitly. Executing all replicates of a row consecutively and executing round-robin are different designs; pick one and record it.

6_scoring.SILENCE_PRECISION: exact and mechanical per execution — a SILENCE row is correct iff zero clarifications were emitted
6_scoring.REQUIRED_RECALL_LOOSE: mechanical per execution — at least one clarification emitted; an upper bound only, never promoted to strict
6_scoring.REQUIRED_RECALL_STRICT: human adjudication of each emitted clarification against the owed fact. The model must not supply these verdicts. Emit a neutral packet pairing every emission with its row, exactly as §175 and §177 did.
6_scoring.rule: adjudication attaches to the exact wording executed; the packet must carry the emissions verbatim and their row text must hash to the frozen value

7_aggregation.perRow: report the per-row rate across replicates — e.g. 2 of 3 executions recovered the owed fact — before any pooling
7_aggregation.perMetric: report the pooled figure only alongside the per-row rates that produced it
7_aggregation.forbidden: reporting a pooled percentage without the per-row distribution, which is what makes a one-row flip look like a trend

8_withinRowDisagreement.requirement: decide the rule in advance and write it down: a row whose replicates disagree is a row with a RATE, not a row that passed or failed
8_withinRowDisagreement.forbidden: majority-voting a row into a clean pass, or discarding a minority execution as an outlier

9_providerContractAndRetryRules.retries: zero, or an explicitly stated policy. A failed call is RECORDED as a failure, never silently retried and never dropped.
9_providerContractAndRetryRules.contractFailure: recorded as CONTRACT_FAILURE and scored as no clarification emitted
9_providerContractAndRetryRules.replacementEvidence: if any mechanism replaces a value, the evidence that the original event occurred must be persisted, not reconstructed afterwards
9_providerContractAndRetryRules.rawPersistence: raw provider output persisted per execution, before normalization

10_caps.providerCallHardCap: state a number; abort at it
10_caps.dollarHardCap: state a number; abort at it

11_successAndRegressionCriteria.mustPreserveBoth: REQUIRED recall AND SILENCE precision. A recall gain accompanied by a precision regression is NOT remediation success.
11_successAndRegressionCriteria.baseline: §175 (4/5 strict recall, 4/5 silence precision) is the causally interpretable baseline. §177's 5/5 precision is an observation whose cause is not established and must not be treated as the bar without its own replicate evidence.
11_successAndRegressionCriteria.writeTheVerdictTableFirst: state, before spend, which combinations of (recall rate, precision rate) count as improvement, as no change, and as regression
11_successAndRegressionCriteria.HR04: state in advance what an HR-04 recovery rate would and would not establish, given that the property hypothesis was derived from that row

interpretationLimitsThatSurviveAnyResult: the corpus is Claude-authored and the evaluated model is Claude-family; a high score does not remove that provenance confound

the truth is PRODUCT_OWNER_REVIEWED_DEVELOPMENT_TRUTH with AI_ASSISTED_HUMAN_VERDICT_GENERATION = TRUE and FULLY_INDEPENDENT_HUMAN_ADJUDICATION = FALSE; a replicate design improves the statistics, not the provenance
ten rows is ten rows. No result generalises beyond this instrument, and none of it establishes production readiness, formal acceptance or customer readiness.

HR-04 recovering under v15 would be consistent with the property repair working AND with the run drawing differently; only the per-row rate across replicates, compared against a v14 replicate set, speaks to the difference

if no v14 replicate set is executed, the comparison is a v15 rate against a v14 single sample, which is better than what exists today but still not a controlled comparison. State which of the two designs is being bought.
notInScopeOfThisRecommendation: nothing here authorizes spend, selects a replicate count, or preregisters anything. It lists the parameters a future preregistration must fix before the first call.
